capabilities: Archive new Codex Desktop tasks as one Markdown note per task
Incrementally update notes when conversations get new replies
Copy local conversation images into vault attachment folders with deduplication
Import local WorkBuddy conversations as notes (experimental)
Link tasks into Dataview daily notes by creation date
disambiguation: Not a daily journaling tool; the daily-note track is an optional feature and the core job is archiving local AI conversations as notes.
extras: Only tasks created after sync is started are imported; WorkBuddy support is labeled experimental and Windows support is still undergoing real-machine validation. README is in Chinese with an English interface option.
problem: AI chat solutions and plans stay locked inside the Codex Desktop app and get buried by newer conversations instead of becoming searchable, linkable vault notes.

relations.evidence: 把本机 WorkBuddy 的对话也存成笔记
可选按创建日把任务链接进 Dataview 每日轨迹

summary: Syncs new local Codex Desktop AI tasks into Markdown notes, preserving user edits and optionally linking tasks into Dataview daily notes.
